skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Remember and understand the concepts of EIA, SEA, identification, analysis, and evaluation of physical impacts of policies, programs, projects, and development activities on the environment.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding nature and methodology of EIA and SEA
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the essence and methodology of EIA and SEA and integrate the results of EIA and SEA into the decision-making process.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Mastering the implementation process of EIA and SEA
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Master the implementation process of EIA and SEA from impact assessment, data collection, data analysis and processing, presentation, and reporting of evaluation results.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Approach and methods for environmental impact assessment
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the approach and methods for environmental impact assessment and ways to reduce and manage negative impacts.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Applying theoretical principles to prepare simple EIA reports
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply theoretical principles, basic models to prepare simple EIA and SEA reports.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Developing discussion, explanation, analysis, and evaluation skills
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop skills for discussion, explanation, analysis, and evaluation of EIA and SEA contents.
Develop the ability to learn independently.
Develop the ability to work in teams with personal responsibility.
